name: Native widescreen assist (no dgVoodoo)
description: Aspect ratio float 1.25->16/9, camera distance 32, FOV ~80deg. Pair with in-game highest resolution / desktop resolution. Not a full mode enumerator rewrite.
usage: In GPU control panel or game options, pick the largest available mode; for true desktop res, windowed + desktop size still helps.
dgVoodoo not required for aspect/camera; still useful for forced res if the menu only lists 4:3 modes.
